name: yanxiaotu
description: Image authenticity examiner that decides whether a picture was AI-generated or edited, layered from cheap to expensive: TC260 AIGC label and EXIF/C2PA metadata parsing, perceptual-hash duplicate search across an image library, then optional ViT/EfficientNet pixel classifiers. Built for e-commerce order-receipt verification and dispute evidence, it returns one of four verdicts with the exact evidence line behind it, and states plainly when the answer is inconclusive instead of guessing.

displayDescription.en: Verifies whether a screenshot or order-receipt photo is AI-generated, edited or reused: reads metadata and the Chinese AIGC label first, then checks duplicates, and only then runs a pixel model, returning evidence you can actually cite.
displayDescription.zh: 核验订单签收图与截图真伪：先读元数据与国标AIGC标识，再查图库重复，再跑像素模型，输出可举证结论。
